rule: Package a story only from a Wikisource scan printed in 1930 or earlier whose story pages are all proofread level 4; otherwise hold with the reason. Titles are reported, never forced.
method: bn.wikisource.org MediaWiki API (User-Agent maison-intake/1.0, sequential, backoff on 429): intitle and exact-phrase full-text search over main and Page namespaces for each story; Index-namespace prefix listings for candidate early collections and periodicals (ছোট*, বিচিত্র*, গল্প*, কথা*, সাধনা*, সবুজ*, ভারতী*, প্রবাসী*, হিতবাদী*); imprint pages of every scan found; proofread quality of the story pages of the only <=1930 transcription found.
